Get a random yes-or-no answer for a light-hearted decision. This free online yes or no generator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. ## How to use the Yes or No Generator

Start by entering your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Enter your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only).
2. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
3. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Yes and No each have a 50% chance. Change the seed for another answer.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Yes or No Generator](/yes-no-generator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.
